limitations: A_eff is inferred from mixed-state splitting, not a bare diagonal hyperfine matrix element.
Recoupled channel weights are diagnostics, not exact integrated spin probabilities.
No independent n=65 experimental splitting benchmark or model uncertainty established.
Historical F=1/2 seed-selected C6 outputs are not recomputed or validated here.
Experimental g-factor comparison supports branch identity, not a complete validation of hyperfine splitting or C6.

scope: Spin probabilities and overlap tracking retain the two 6sns channels and numerical Coulomb/Numerov radial functions.
Other configurations/no_me channels and exact inner-region contributions are not a complete all-electron spin projection.
Weak-field slope check uses three n=65 S states at +/-0.001 and +/-0.0005 G; not the 05.18 finite-field scan.
TDM uses the same single-active-electron model, not an independent absolute experimental calibration.
Experimental g factors check state identity; they do not validate C6 or the exact hyperfine splitting.
